review_summary: Independent external JARVIS review approves the repaired V01 Layer 04 central-merchandise and circulation candidate a3d00e7526313425428e1375d0765ad652a12d9ee43883815a83abacc193ba8e. The exact GitHub Actions artifact 9369801718 was downloaded and candidate.png independently hashed to a3d00e7526313425428e1375d0765ad652a12d9ee43883815a83abacc193ba8e, matching the artifact manifest, published state and provenance. The exact approved repaired Layer 03 parent 8e2a2b196904a132c2c18ffd20f7035cf1689656ccea1c3cc871aa714ccc2bba was also retrieved from its approved artifact and independently hash-verified before visual comparison. Direct full-resolution parent-versus-candidate inspection shows that the new visible contribution is confined to the central freestanding merchandise rack and its immediate floor pool. The rack gains a restrained warm 3000K lift that improves package readability and gives the centre of the circulation path a deliberate third-tier visual role without challenging the sweet counters or wall merchandise. The front sweet counters remain the strongest destination, the wall shelf compositions remain second, central merchandise remains third, rear hospitality stays subdued, and the ceiling remains visually quiet. The added light reads as concealed or deep-recessed support rather than a visible fixture, raw strip, glowing ceiling aperture or broad ambient wash. Camera, crop, perspective, architecture, ceiling grid, counters, shelves, products, furniture, materials and previously approved Layer 01 through Layer 03 lighting remain visually frozen. No global exposure or gamma lift is apparent. The effect is subtle but clearly legible in direct comparison and strong enough to justify its own presentation layer while preserving the repaired zero-drift chain.
